description: This file defines the App class for the Slim Framework, which extends RouteCollectorProxy and implements RequestHandlerInterface. It manages middleware, routing, error handling, and application execution for a Slim app.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application class for Slim Framework, managing middleware, routing, error handling, and request handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the App with response factory, container, resolvers, and middleware dispatcher.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds middleware to the middleware dispatcher stack.

methods.name: addRoutingMiddleware
methods.description: Adds Slim's built-in routing middleware to the stack.

methods.name: addErrorMiddleware
methods.description: Adds Slim's built-in error middleware with configuration options.

methods.name: addBodyParsingMiddleware
methods.description: Adds body parsing middleware with optional parsers.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the application, handling the request and emitting the response.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes a request through middleware and returns the response, handling HEAD method specifics.
